bio: With a penchant for seasonal and regional produce, this restaurant serves flavoursome dishes including freshwater fish specialities and Wiener schnitzel. The imposing historical building, which also houses the famous Burgtheater, makes for a unique location; with its striking columns and gorgeous stuccowork, the stylish interior has a typically Viennese feel. Incidentally, the restaurant premises once served as a private carriage entrance for Emperor Franz Joseph I and Empress Elisabeth when they attended the theatre....
